name: Paraxylene adsorption and crystallisation
applications: paraxylene for purified terephthalic acid and polyester
principle: Mixed xylenes from reformate and transalkylation are fed to a simulated-moving-bed adsorption unit. A rotary valve moves feed, desorbent and product ports along beds of selective adsorbent so that, in effect, a counter-current moving bed is created without moving solids; paraxylene is adsorbed and then desorbed, and the desorbent is recovered by distillation. The raffinate is isomerised and recycled to extinction.
